text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear. Is this what they call... a
"breakout"?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I am... but it seems the new skincare
product I
purchased doesn't quite get
along with my skin.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'll refrain from using it anymore, and
wait for my
skin to heal itself.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...While hoping that doesn't take too
long.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr continues to worry
about her
skin for some time.
